title: A History of Sierra Leone
author: Christopher Fyfe
notes: Magisterial historical narrative documenting Sierra Leone from coastal precolonial trade through colonial administration up to 1961.

title: Witness to Truth: Report of the Sierra Leone Truth and Reconciliation Commission
author: Sierra Leone Truth and Reconciliation Commission
notes: Definitive multi-volume investigation into the causes, nature, atrocities, and governance failures of the Sierra Leone Civil War (1991–2002).

title: Bunce Island: A British Slave Castle in Sierra Leone
author: Joseph Opala
publisher: James Madison University / Sierra Leone Heritage
notes: Detailed historical and archaeological study of Bunce Island slave castle and its rice-trade connection to South Carolina and Georgia.

title: The Black Loyalists: The Search for a Promised Land in Nova Scotia and Sierra Leone 1783-1870
author: James W. St. G. Walker
notes: Definitive study on the Black Loyalists from the American Revolution who migrated from Nova Scotia to found Freetown in 1792.

title: Sierra Leone's Greatest Hero: Bai Bureh and the 1898 Hut Tax War
author: LaRay Denzer
publisher: Journal of the Historical Society of Sierra Leone
notes: Analytical study of Chief Bai Bureh's military tactics, political strategy, and anti-tax guerrilla resistance against British colonial expansion.

title: The Athens of West Africa: A History of International Education at Fourah Bay College, 1827-1950
author: Daniel J. Paracka Jr.
notes: Explores the institutional and pan-African history of Fourah Bay College as West Africa's pioneer university.

title: Ebola Virus Disease in West Africa - Sierra Leone Situation Report
author: World Health Organization (WHO)
notes: Comprehensive epidemiological tracking and public health data on the 2014–2016 Ebola virus epidemic in Sierra Leone.
